note: Independent re-audit against RFC 4724 Section 4.2 and current gr.go/gr_state.go (post-18b491ae23). Section 4.2 requires immediate removal of retained stale routes for a family on re-establishment when the new GR capability clears F, omits the family, or is absent altogether. In onSessionReestablished, newCap==nil stops all timers and purges every stale family, while reconnectKeepsFamily returns false whenever !grForwarding[fam], purging that family and stopping any LLST timer on it; handleStructuredState dispatches source purge-stale per purged family. All 5 tagged units verified: TestRFC4724ReestablishedWithoutForwardingStatePurgesTheFamily covers all three triggers (F clear, family omitted, cap 65 only) through JSON handleEvent OPEN + UP; TestRFC4724ReestablishedWithoutCapabilityPurgesOnTheStructuredPath covers cap-65-only and empty-optional-params on the structured OPEN/DOWN/OPEN/UP path; TestGRStateManagerReconnectFBitZero tests per-family F=0 purge vs F=1 keep; TestGRStateManagerReconnectWithFBit and TestRFC4724ReestablishedWithForwardingStateKeepsTheRoutes verify F=1 keeps stale routes with zero purges.
